Volatile acid can be prepared by the action of less volatile acid with the salt of corresponding more volatile acid. The solution of hydrogen chloride gas i.e. hydrochloric acid is a volatile acid. Therefore, hydrogen chloride gas is prepared by heating its salt, sodium chloride, with less volatile concentrated sulphuric acid. The gas is collected by upward displacement of air since it is water soluble and heavier than air.
